title: Research: prove the P112 frame packing maximum is thirteen
body:
## Summary

Prove that the literal P112 labels have maximum disjoint binary orthonormal 8-frame packing number exactly thirteen, closing PR3356 open question 1.

```diff
-13 <= packing number <= 14
+packing number = 13
+fourteen-frame partition: exhaustively excluded
+two-support even-group colouring floor: 28 -> 30 channels
```

The contribution is ten new files in `research/p112-frame-partition/`: exact source pins, the retained thirteen-frame witness, a seven-generator symmetry reduction, two separately implemented exhaustive searches, registered replay and a written proof. The thirty-channel statement applies to the even-group colouring construction. It is not a general fitting-rank lower bound or a native COPY price.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3356 `a91a44a049cd6114d0edaea714914b64f90c601d` exhibited thirteen frames and left fourteen open. Matarener/Mark's PR3335 supplied the earlier packing and rematching question.
- **After:** both source enumerations recover all 4,032 frames and the identical census digest. Seven literal source-preserving transformations give orbits of sizes 448 and 3,584. Every partition reduces to one fixed ordinary-frame case or the all-special case. Both complete ordinary searches return UNSAT after 53,202,862 nodes. Primary fixed-special exhaustion takes 701 nodes; the independent unfixed-special exhaustion takes 21,808. The retained thirteen-frame witness passes again.
- Frozen Python 3.12 registered replay, optimized direct replay, twelve primary controls including 32 complete tiny subset-oracle fixtures, strict C++ compilation, Clang static analysis and Ruff pass. Both implementations pass ASan/UBSan controls and a 100,000-node prefix. Full sanitized searches and hosted CI are not claimed.
- Committed-byte/source-history preflight and both complete Git-free committed-export checks pass on `31e42fdf7771734f1c848d2306bccef1bce54155`. The canonical Discussion update links the public source and exact result.

Canonical baseline is `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, priority revision 6. The sole replay input is an existing main-ancestor file; no pending Git object or solver installation is required. Exact commands and limits are in the README.

Credit PR3356, Matarener/Mark PR3335 and the retained ctoth, ywz65, Sagar Thakrar, Cinna Davis, Adam Gall, Jeremy Diviney and Philippe Van Velzen lineage. The later [Tekalign order-seven claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587#discussioncomment-19007978) independently studies two cyclic frame orbits under that symmetry. This full-domain exclusion uses different generators and imports none of that restricted claim's evidence. [Canonical claim and finding](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587#discussioncomment-19007973).

This is a finite computational proof with two implementations. No proof-assistant review, arbitrary-fitting-rank theorem, native supplier, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed. Fifteen-group attainability and non-colouring/native implementation costs remain open.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

Only one new scoped package is added. Frozen sources, shared checkers, suppliers and the selected record are unchanged.
